heading: Behind the app: the Marginarium
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns any photo into a paint-by-numbers template on the device, and its Marginarium tells how it was made.
content_why: A short chapter list keeps the page quiet and clear, and the stories wait for the app rather than crowding the README.
avoid: Custom banners, badges or animated chrome on the README, where a plain line of text does the job.
